applicability: repositories whose review signal is an asynchronous bot pass; excludes repositories with a blocking required-review gate, which enforces this mechanically
destination: AGENTS.md Opening a pull request (automated review lands after you open)

evidence.source_reference: PR #116 merge/revert timeline and PR #121 review comments

expected_behavior: A pull request is not reported finished, and not merged, until the automated review passes have landed and every comment is dispositioned as applied or declined with a reason.
observation: This repository's automated review posts two to five minutes after a pull request is opened. A PR merged four minutes after opening was reverted when its P1 landed two minutes after the merge, and a later PR was reported finished at open while three valid comments were still in flight -- one of them a correct refutation of a claim that would otherwise have promoted an unsupported rule into AGENTS.md.
reason: Operator approved the destination edit 2026-08-11 after the second occurrence; the rule ships in the same change that records it.
